title: 30 Best New Job Gifts, Presents & Gift Ideas for Every Budget
summary: 30 thoughtful new job gift ideas for him, her, or anyone starting fresh sorted by budget, from fun under-$30 picks to premium branded sets they'll love.
body_markdown:
Looking for a welcome gift for a new employee? It’s essential to note that a cookie-cutter approach to new job gift ideas—or any corporate gift, in general—won’t make a lasting impact or leave your recipient with a great impression. Instead, opt for personalized welcome gifts for new employees that are tailored to each recipient.


‍


From custom-branded items to gifts that resonate with your recipients' hobbies or interests to practical items made better with personalization, those extra details are key in showing that you care. Here we’ve pulled together 35 work gift ideas to help you make every new hire feel valued and excited to be part of the team.


‍


## New Job Gift Ideas Anyone Would Love


Quality personalized products do more than make a great first impression. They set the tone for everything that follows. Start building brand loyalty from day one, so your new hire doesn't just feel welcomed, they feel like part of the team.


‍


### Personalized Gifts


When it comes to personalized welcome[gifts for new employees](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/corporate-gifts) , you have plenty of options! From custom apparel like varsity jackets and other custom apparel to personalized drinkware and gear, these picks can only get better when branded for your company!


‍


#### 1. Varsity Coach Jacket


For a versatile jacket your employees will love and get lots of use out of, choose a simple, unisex, lightweight jacket in a neutral color like this one and add your logo. It’s an easy way to delight your recipient without breaking your budget.


‍


*Shown: Custom Coach Jacket*


‍


#### 2. Personalized Drinkware


[Custom water bottles](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-water-bottles) and branded tumblers are a solid hit with new hires. Take notes from Stanley, the tumbler that does it holds a lot, fits in a cup holder, keeps drinks cold, is dishwasher-safe, and started an internet sensation.


‍


*Shown: Stanley Tumbler*


‍


#### 3. Embroidered Hoodie


[Custom hoodies and logo sweatshirts](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/sweatshirts-logo) continue to be a game-changer, but for the best picks, it comes down to the details. Top-notch customization, soft fabrications, kangaroo pockets make for details that keep your new job gift gift idea in solid rotation.


‍


*Shown: Contrast-Stitch Mad Happy Hoodie*


‍


#### 4. Custom Backpack


Durable, functional, and of course, a style staple they’ll love shouting off. When it comes to backpacks that turn heads, you can’t beat[custom backpacks for employees](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-backpacks-for-employees) .


*Shown: Timbuk2 Roll Top Backpack*


‍


#### 5. Branded Bucket Hat


Classy and sophisticated meets low-key cool with a well-branded,[custom bucket hat](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-bucket-hats) . featuring a tone-on-tone logo tag. Extra sun protection, a style younger generations love, and easy to ship straight to their door.


‍


*Photo courtesy of jjjjound; Shown: jjjjound Bucket Hat*


‍


### Office Essentials


Want welcome gifts for new employees that create a productive and welcoming workspace while making your employees feel valued from day one? Practical items like organizers and project planners, or high-quality notebooks, totes, backpacks, and the like, can boost their organizational skills and overall efficiency. Plus, they make[great gifts for remote hires](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/best-new-remote-hires-gifts) too.


‍


#### 6. Upgraded Notebook


Custom office staples, like[branded notebooks](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/branded-notebooks) , are the nice-to-have practical gift they’ll appreciate. To make yours a standout gift (instead of just something from the closet supply room) look for features like water-resistant book cloth cover, foil stamping, premium paper, and perforated sheets.


‍


*Shown: Appointed Notebook*


‍


#### 7. Custom Stickers


‍Stickers are a fun and easy way for your recipients to personalize their laptop covers, notebooks, drinkware, and more. If you’re looking for the perfect finishing touch for your[new employee swag kits](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/employee-swag-kits-2020) , don’t overlook colorful, on-brand stickers—they add personality and make every item feel unique.


‍


*Photo courtesy of A24 Films; Shown: A24 Logo Stickers*


‍


#### 8. Custom Carry All Tote


Whatever your logo, whatever your logo, whatever your fonts, are[custom sustainable tote bags](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/sustainable-tote-bags) just waiting for you to leave your mark! Ready to brand your ultimate tote bag? Talk to your Gemnote rep for personalization options that turn this everyday essential into a first day at a new job gift that’s both functional and unforgettable.


‍


*Shown: Figma Cursor Tote*


‍


#### 9. Custom Backpack


Hard-working, reliable, and always up for the challenge—just like your top performers. The best gifts for a new job should reflect the same qualities you value in your team, and this spacious, durable Incase backpack checks every box.


‍


With its sleek design, ample storage, and professional polish, it’s ideal for commutes, business travel, or day-to-day office life. If you're looking for work gift ideas that are practical and impressive, this backpack is a great way to make a strong first impression and help get your new employees off to a great start.


‍


*Shown: InCase Backpack*


‍


#### 10. Project Planner


Ready to set the tone for a successful onboarding experience? For the best new employee[welcome kit ideas](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/employee-welcome-kit-ideas-for-hr-talent-teams) think office essentials like pens, notebooks, a project planner, customized snacks, totes, and backpacks. A sleek project planner isn’t just practical—it’s one of those gift ideas for a new job that helps new hires feel focused, prepared, and ready to tackle their first big assignment with confidence.


‍


*Shown: Poketo Project Planner*


‍


### Tech Gadgets


Want to really make your new hire feel appreciated? Tech gadgets make fun gifts for the news members of your team since they not only offer entertainment but can also enhance productivity in the modern workplace! Items like wireless earbuds or a portable charger always come in handy while showing your company’s desire to keep employees connected and engaged. Just don’t forget to order extras for your employee swag store or to give as holiday gifts to your hard-working team.


‍


#### 11. Wireless Earbuds


Thinking about custom earbuds for your welcome gifts for new employees? It’s a smart move. Tech accessories are always appreciated, especially when they enhance productivity and comfort on the job.


‍


For a standout first day at a new job gift, look for earbuds with features like voice-activated volume control and the ability to hop into conversations without taking them out. These JBL earbuds are a new-hire favorite for good reason—they’re sleek, functional, and make settling into a new role that much easier.


‍


*Shown: JBL Earbuds*


‍


#### 12. Extra Long Power Cable


[Phone chargers](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/custom-phone-chargers) make functional new job gift ideas. However, if you're really looking to impress your new hires, choose the ones that offer added convenience and a lot of style, kind of like this innovative design from Native Union, which features a weighted knot that prevents the cord from slipping onto the floor.


‍


*Shown: Native Union 10-ft Night Cable in Zebra*


‍


#### 13. Waterproof Power Bank


There are power banks and then there are portable, durable, dust and waterproof, drop-resistant, charging banks that were made for adventures! If you're looking to impress your new hire, gift them a rugged power bank that really goes the distance, like this one from My Charge.


‍


*Shown: My Charge Waterproof Power Bank*


‍


#### 14. Snap 3-in-1 charger


The best gifts for new job are multi-tasking, tech faves! With a multi-device charging station, like this one from Native Union, you can help your new hire add style, convenience, and efficiency to their workstation.


‍


*Shown: Native Union Snap 3-in-1 Charger*


‍


### Coffee and Tea Lovers


Coffee and tea gifts are ideal for new employees because they provide a warm and comforting way to start the workday while fostering a sense of belonging and relaxation in the workplace!


‍


#### 15. Camp Cup


This stainless steel camp cup from Miir is available in eight colors and four sizes to fit your branding needs. Best of all, it's vacuum-sealed, so coffee and other beverages stay hot longer whether they’re sitting around a campfire or while working hard at your desk.


‍


*Shown: Miir Camp Cup*


‍


#### 16. Double-Walled Glass Matcha Shaker with Infuser


The best new job gift ideas are infused with convenience and are tailored to fit your recipients’ personalities. Thankfully, the double-walled glass matcha shaker and infuser means your new hire can have their favorite cup of tea anytime.


‍


*Shown: Art of Tea Double Walled Glass Matcha Shaker with Infuser*


‍


### Everyday Basic Gifts


Every day, basic gifts like socks, caps, towels, and water bottles are great for new hires because they offer both practicality and versatility. Plus, they demonstrate thoughtfulness and care for employees' needs and foster a positive and comfortable workplace environment from the very beginning.


‍


#### 17. Branded Water Bottle


Drinking water is important for everyone, whether they are on or off the clock. To help your employee stay hydrated throughout the day, give them a branded water bottle they’ll love toting around.


‍


*Shown: Customized Water Bottle*


‍


#### 18. Custom Crew Socks


Who couldn't use an extra pair of great socks? Essentials, like these striped crew socks, are a fun way to show off your branding. Plus, when it comes to new employee welcome gift ideas, this one has plenty of style—and won't break the bank!


‍


*Shown: Escuyer Stripe Crew Socks*


‍


#### 19. Logo Towel


A lot of effort went into designing your logo, so why not show it off on an ultra-plush and absorbent branded towel? It's the one your new hire will reach for on repeat.


‍


*Photo courtesy of A24 Films; Shown: A24 Logo Towel*


‍


#### 20. Branded Nylon Cap


You can't go wrong with a great branded cap! From offering shade on sunny days to alleviating any bad hair day, adding your logo to a great nylon hat will help your recipient keep their cool no matter what their first week brings!


‍


*Photo courtesy of Only NY; Shown: Only NY Nylon Cap*


‍


#### 21. Zip Duck Bag


Reusable tote bags are all the rage, but what makes this heavyweight bag even better is the added durability and zip top to keep all of your new hire’s essentials safe and secure. Choose one like this from Baggu that offers style and sustainability, thanks to the recycled cotton canvas and packaging, and make your new employee welcome gift even more thoughtful.


‍


*Shown: Baggu Zip Duck Bag*


‍


### Travel Essentials


Travel essentials make the perfect new employee welcome gift! Whether their role requires business trips and work-related travel or not, branded gear like accessory bags, totes, coolers, and the like make weekend trips and everyday life easier.


‍


#### 22. Rains Small Wash Bag


With its minimal design and waterproof fabrication, the Rains small wash bag is sized for toiletries and looks great on the road or on the bathroom counter. Need a new employee welcome gift that goes the distance? This wash bag can double as a pencil case and is perfect for stashing in larger bags.


‍


*Shown: Rains Small Wash Bag*


‍


#### 23. Branded Hip Bag


Fanny packs continue to trend—and for good reason. Once associated primarily with tourists, these hands-free bags made a comeback and have remained a fashionable, functional staple for everyday use. That’s why a well-designed fanny pack makes an excellent gift for someone starting a new job—it’s both thoughtful and practical, offering convenience while helping them stay organized during their daily routine.


‍


*Shown: Custom Hip Pack*


‍


#### 24. Puffy Cooler Bag


A chill gift that keeps drinks and snacks cool—literally. This puffy cooler from Baggu comes in a variety of fun, colorful patterns (including color-blocking!) and makes a standout gift.


‍


*Shown: Baggu Puffy Cooler Bag*


‍


#### 25. Air Tag + Holder


New hires have a lot thrown at them as soon as they walk in the door! From on the job duties and file locations to the names of everyone they meet, gifting them with an item that takes some of the pressure off, like remembering keeping track of their stuff, is always appreciated!


‍


*Shown: Apple Air Tag and Nomad Goods Air Tag Holder*


‍


### Corporate Gifts


The best[corporate gifts](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/corporate-gifts) fit your company’s branding perfectly and keep your logo front and center! While tons of products can be customized, these offer the quality, professionalism, and functional style your new hires will appreciate!


‍


#### 26. Rover Pack


For the best in Customizable backpacks, think extra features like padded laptop sleeves and pockets galore! Kind of like this Rover pack from Topo Designs with its flap pocket, zippered pockets, water bottle pockets, and more!


‍


*Shown: Topo Designs Rover Pack*


‍


#### 27. Custom Hat


Glossier offers the perfect dose of inspiration with their You Look Good cap! Want your brand to look good too? Why not customize with your tagline, website URL, event name, or the like? Just don’t forget to add your logo!


‍


*Photo Courtesy of Glossier; Shown: Glossier You Look Good Cap*


‍


#### 28. Long-Sleeve Logo Tee


From casual Fridays and chilly commutes to work from home days and even weekends, nothing beats a soft long-sleeved tee that shows off your brand!


‍


*Photo courtesy of Only NY; Shown: Only NY Surveyor Long Sleeve T-Shirt*


‍


#### 29. Carhartt Lunch Can Cooler


Lunch can coolers make excellent corporate gifts thanks to their versatility and everyday appeal. Whether it’s for office lunches, company picnics, tailgating, or weekend getaways, a durable and stylish lunch cooler is always a win.


‍


Take this one from Carhartt, for example—it’s built to handle the elements while keeping meals fresh and drinks cold. It’s the kind of practical yet elevated item that makes a standout welcome gift for a new employee, showing that your company values both function and thoughtful design right from day one.


‍


*Shown: Carhartt Lunch Can Cooler*


‍


#### 30. Logo Umbrella


The best welcome gifts for new employees are practical, customizable items that can be used in and out of the office. Kind of like this compact umbrella from a 24 Films. Want to make your own? Talk to your Gemnote rep for the[best branded umbrella options](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/company-umbrellas) that make your company shine.


‍


*Photo courtesy of A24 Films; Shown: A24 Logo Umbrella*

## FAQs


Frequently Asked Questions for the best new hIre gifts.


‍


### What is a good gift for someone starting a new job?


The best new job gifts are personal, practical, and high quality. Think custom apparel they'll actually wear, tech accessories that make their workday easier, or office essentials that help them feel settled and set up for success. The key is skipping generic items and opting for something that shows you put thought into it before they even walked in the door.


‍


### **How much should you spend on a new employee welcome gift?**


It depends on your budget and goals, but there's a great option at every price point. Custom socks, stickers, and totes are thoughtful and affordable, while tech gadgets like wireless earbuds or a multi-device charger make a bigger splash. Most companies land somewhere in between, putting together a curated welcome kit that feels generous without going overboard.


‍


### **What should be included in a new hire welcome kit?**


A great new hire welcome kit can include a mix of items. Branded apparel, a drinkware item, an office essential like a notebook or planner, and a fun add-on like stickers or socks makes for a great kit. However, getting creative is part of the fun and your Gemnotre Rep can help you find items that stand out and get noticed.


‍


### **Should new employee gifts be branded or unbranded?**


Branded, without question. A high-quality item with your logo does double duty: it makes your new hire feel like part of the team and keeps your company top of mind every time they use it. The trick is choosing products worth putting your name on. A well-made branded item becomes something they're proud to carry. A cheap one ends up in a drawer.


‍


### **What are the best new employee gifts for remote workers?**


For remote hires, think shippable and functional. Custom drinkware, branded apparel, wireless earbuds, portable chargers, and travel accessories all make excellent remote new hire gifts because they're easy to ship and genuinely useful outside of an office setting. A curated welcome kit sent straight to their door goes a long way in making a remote employee feel connected to the team from day one.


‍


### **Can you customize new hire gifts in bulk?**


Yes, and it's easier than you might think. We specializes in sourcing, customizing, and delivering branded welcome gifts at scale, whether you're onboarding fifty new hires or five hundred. Your dedicated Gemnote rep will help you find the right products, nail the branding, and stay on budget. Reach out to get started.


‍


### **What makes a new employee welcome gift memorable?**


The details. A memorable welcome gift is high quality, thoughtfully chosen, and personalized in a way that feels intentional rather than generic. It does not have to be expensive. It just has to show that someone put real thought into it. When a new hire opens a welcome kit and feels like it was made for them, that impression sticks and so does their excitement about joining your team.
